claims.sentence: In a separate study of annotated corpus of 3,063 citations to 100 highly cited biomedical articles, about 39\% contained an accuracy error \citep{sarol2024citationintegrity}.
claims.claim: Annotated corpus of 3,063 citations to 100 highly cited biomedical articles; ~39% had accuracy errors.
claims.excerpt: We manually annotated 100 highly-cited biomedical publications (reference articles) and citations to them. ... A total of 3063 citation instances were annotated (39.18% with accuracy errors).
